mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a resource forgone to have goods or services."
Cost is a resource forgone to have goods or services.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a predetermined calculation of how much cost should be under specific working conditions."
Standard cost is a predetermined calculation of how much cost should be under specific working conditions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible to the internal management."
Management accountant is responsible to the internal management.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the time where managers use "what-if" technique to examine the outcome of an event if the predicted data are not achieved or if there are changes in underlying assumptions."
Sensitivity analysis is the time where managers use "what-if" technique to examine the outcome of an event if the predicted data are not achieved or if there are changes in underlying assumptions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an opportunity given to lower levels managers to make decisions."
Decentralisation is an opportunity given to lower levels managers to make decisions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a future cost which is different for different alternatives."
Relevant cost is a future cost which is different for different alternatives.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a guide for internal activities."
Control accounting is a guide for internal activities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used by those outside the company, like regulatory agencies, tax authorities, investors, lenders and trade partners."
External reporting is used by those outside the company, like regulatory agencies, tax authorities, investors, lenders and trade partners.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an imputed cost that is a real economic cost of the amount of investment financed by the equity."
The cost equity is an imputed cost that is a real economic cost of the amount of investment financed by the equity.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined by the Chartered Institute of Management Accountants (CIMA) as "a quantitative expression of a plan for a defined period of time."
Budget is defined by the Chartered Institute of Management Accountants (CIMA) as "a quantitative expression of a plan for a defined period of time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the difference between the actual price paid for purchased materials and their standard cost (CIMA)."
Direct material price variance is the difference between the actual price paid for purchased materials and their standard cost (CIMA).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a unit of an organisation where the manager is responsible for all activities taking place there including revenue, cost and investment decisions."
Responsibility centre is a unit of an organisation where the manager is responsible for all activities taking place there including revenue, cost and investment decisions.
